milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The birch fence gate is placed at spawn-relative (7, 0, 4) on the south wall of the enclosure. The player must navigate near it and face it to confirm visual identification. max_distance=16 allows detection from the cobblestone path (~8 blocks from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the gate rather than just passing by.

Uses inventory_has because this is a mine task - when the birch trapdoor is broken with the provided iron axe, it drops itself as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no birch_trapdoor in inventory, so detecting min_count=1 reliably confirms the trapdoor at (7, 0, 7) was successfully mined.
